update_database_spend: update database spend for an LLM request with token, user, team, org, and response cost
enqueue_tool_registry_upsert: enqueue tool names discovered from LLM request and response for batch upsert into the tool registry
commit_spend_updates_to_db_with_redis: commit in-memory spend updates to Redis then acquire a pod lock to flush them to the database
update_daily_user_spend: update the daily user spend table with aggregated transaction data using batch upsert with deadlock prevention
update_daily_team_spend: update the daily team spend table with aggregated transaction data using batch upsert with deadlock prevention
